title: Evaluator verdict
description: The fresh-context evaluator's structured verdict for one task group. Produced through `claude -p --output-format json --json-schema` by scripts/run-evaluator.sh; the CLI validates it, the script renders <TG>-verdict.md from it and keeps the object as <TG>-verdict.json.

summary.description: Two or three sentences; file:line, never pasted logs.

criteria.description: One entry per criterion ID in scope, every one of them.

findings.description: BLOCKING findings drive NEEDS_WORK; ADVISORY findings never do.

criterion.description: The criterion ID, or '-' for a cross-cutting finding.

evidence.description: What in the file or evidence shows it.

images_opened.description: Image evidence paths actually opened with Read.
